identity: 256-bit key inherited from pulse_context_join; unique among all active slots and no reuse while stale producers may remain
admission: Lowest free slot; duplicate active identity or full pool rejects; no same-edge retirement/admission bypass
results: Statistics and noise independently route by full key; can target different slots on same edge; unknown identities consumed and explicitly rejected
output: Round robin among completed slots; selected slot latched and held through backpressure until result handshake; one selection bubble allowed
cancel_all: Discard local slots and output lock only; caller owns external cancellation, reference release and epoch discipline
reset: All slots empty and arbitration reset; no guaranteed protection if caller reuses an old complete key
capacity_boundary: Four logical contexts are not an implicit mapping to four physical RAM banks or all sixteen capture banks; upstream must perform joint resource admission
